bestBets.overview: VORONYA won a couple in a row at Pioneer Park before going to Darwin for the Cup carnival and placing in both his starts. That form good enough to get away with this. BRAZEN SAILOR is threatening to win. He has just found one better in his last three starts and would not leave him out of exotics. SPLISH SPLASH was beaten less than 2 lengths here last start. Drawn to get ideal run and she will be in mix while BAD MAN was poor last start, but he had been racing well prior and prepared to forget one bad run.

raceTips.comment: Voronya clearly the one to beat. Undefeated at the track, he was good last start behind two smart types and in a race devoid of speed he can roll forward and prove hard to beat.

bestBets.overview: HIGHSTRUNG started favourite here last start and finally got his maiden out of the way. He meets a similar field and the extra 100m will suit. He can win again. STARTYOURENGINE chased home Highstrung when beaten less than a length here last start. Placed in his last three starts and this a winnable race. RIVERINA WALTZ got her maiden out of the way here two starts back then she just held ground last start. She will be competitive in this while EPIC JEWEL has only been battling at Darwin in recent starts but she may grab a first four spot.

raceTips.comment: Not a race I’m keen to bet into. Highstrung and Riverina Waltz are the two map horses. They should settle first and second in running and be afforded every chance from there. Startyourengine found the line well behind Highstrung last start. The rise in trip should suit and he can turn the tables because of that.

bestBets.overview: LUSKIN HERO started a short favourite and demolished a similar field here last start. He rarely runs a bad race and if he produces similar performance will be winning again. DELAGO LAD battled on well enough when placed here two starts back then held ground in small field last start. He will not be far away. ROCK OF KRYPTONITE won with something in hand here two starts back then was touch disappointing last start. He can bounce back while LUCKY FORTUNA chased home well into minor placing last start. She can sneak a first four spot.

raceTips.comment: Luskin Hero on top. He is just racing so well and happy to stick with him. Drawn nicely, he should roll forward and prove hard to beat again. Bahama Bay should find this easier than the last two races he has contested. He loves racing here and can improve. Rock Of Kryptonite usually races well fresh but 1200m might be 100m too far for him.

bestBets.overview: ONLY THE BEST started favourite here last start and finished too well for clear win here last start. Should get his chance at some stage in straight. REVOLUTION RISING comes off a strong last start placing in small field last start. Drawn to get all the favours and he will be in finish again. BONNY IMPACT has been threatening to win having been placed in her last two starts. Cannot leave her out of exotics while HIGH AMBITIONS is having first start in the Territory. Mixed form in Victoria but this a nice race for Pioneer Park debut.

raceTips.comment: Market late should tell the story with a lot of the runners here. Only The Best had been settling back in his races, and when sent forward last start proved too good. If similar tactics are applied, then he looks a good bet. Bonny Impact drops in class and has been racing well of late. Dad Bod has also been taking a sit lately and racing below his best. If he rolls forward, look for an improved showing.

bestBets.overview: STELLA BYSTARLIGHT was strong winning here three starts back then she has backed that up with a couple of placings since. Has won a couple at this distance range and she can get away with this. LIMITED RISK only battled away here last start. He had been placed in two runs prior and can bounce back in this. NASHA only just missed this track/distance two starts back before poor effort last start. Prepared to forget one bad run while VALLEY PRINCE only battled here last start but he had been placed in two runs prior and must consider.

raceTips.comment: Two key chances in Limited Risk and Stella Bystarlight. Stella Bystarlight should find the front and comes here in great form. She has a good record over the track and trip and will give a sight. Limited Risk had excuses last start but still found the line well. He has been racing well of late and comes here on the quick back up. Can improve.

bestBets.overview: SCISSOR ME TIMBERS finished too well winning here two starts back then he started favourite last start but was too bad to be true. Drawn perfectly and can bounce back from one poor run. CAPISTAN is threatening to win. He has been placed in last three starts and that form good enough to be competitive in this. THE BIG FREEZE won a couple in a row earlier this campaign then not been disgraced last couple. He will be in mix again while FOREVER A DIAMOND is still eligible for maiden but she has been racing well and comes off a last start placing.

raceTips.comment: Three key chances in Scissor Me Timbers, The Big Freeze and Forever A Diamond. Scissor Me Timbers was good two starts ago, leading all the way and proving too good. That meant he started favourite last start, where he sat outside the leader but was beaten on the turn, dropping out to finish last. If he can recapture his form from two starts ago he is the one to beat. The Big Freeze has tactical speed but has been getting back in his races of late. He easily accounted for Scissor Me Timbers last start and stays as his preferred trip. Tactics will be key with him. Forever A Diamond was good two runs back against some smart types. That being said, she is still a maiden and is hard to back off that.

bestBets.overview: HIGHLANDS won here two starts back then beaten less than a length by Flying Start last start. Looking for him to turn-the-tables in this. FLYING START finished too well and got the prize beating Highlands here last start. Should get the perfect run in behind the speed and no reason he cannot win again. GRINZINGER LASS won here two starts back then filled the minor place behind Flying Start last outing. She can figure in exotics while MR JONES won last time he was at Pioneer Park and he is a must for first four players.

raceTips.comment: Highlands was good last start, leading all the way and just finding one better late. He maps to control this race again and will give an almighty sight. The only knock is the step up in trip, but if he handles that he should be winning. Grinzinger Bishop was okay to the line last start. He comes out of a quality race and can improve on the quick back up. Flying Start will likely be spotting his main rival a start but found the line well last and the small field should suit.
